newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' debt at 1.148 trln pesos at end-June.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' debt at 1.148 trln pesos at end-June.

text.p: The Philippine government's total debt stock stood at 1.148 trillion pesos as of June 30, data released by the Department of Finance on Sunday showed.
The debt level slipped from 1.155 trillion pesos registered in December 1996.
Domestic debt totalled 734.539 billion pesos, while foreign debt reached $15.668 billion, or 413.409 billion pesos.
The government used the 26.40 pesos-to-$1 conversion rate which was the prevailing rate by end-June, as against the 29.490 closing rate last Friday.
As of December 1996, domestic debt was at 742.057 billion pesos, while foreign debt stood at $15.717 billion or an equivalent of 413.180 billion pesos.
